editionLabel: CrowD Games · English summary of the Russian base manual · combat and world exploration · 1–4 players
firstPlayerRule: No fixed starting player is required: during pilot actions in combat or world exploration, players may act simultaneously or take actions in any order.
houseFallback: If your group wants to decide who resolves a shared interaction first, agree on a player or pick one at random. This does not set an order for later actions.
clarifications: Players can interleave their actions; one player does not have to finish all their available actions before another begins. Resolve interactions with the same hex or enemy in combat, or the same object in world exploration, one at a time.

In combat, the pilot phase has three steps: roll dice, place dice and perform actions, then update combat effects. Everyone finishes the current step before the next begins. Rolling and updating effects can be simultaneous.

World exploration has its own round phases: reduce vigor, perform pilot actions, then end the round. Everyone finishes the current phase before moving on; the first and third phases can be simultaneous.

Campaign setup lets each player choose a starting pilot and ship. It does not specify a priority for those choices or appoint a starting leader. Read the scenario's setup and special rules before beginning; the separate scenario book was not reviewed for this answer.

Players first choose a space-event option together. If they cannot agree, page 35 has each player roll four action dice: most stress faces decides, with tied players rerolling. This settles that event choice; it does not choose the first player or create a general initiative tie-break.
This summarizes the preserved Russian main manual. Expansion rules and the separately listed FAQ and errata were not reviewed; follow your scenario and any applicable corrections.

The source link opens the publisher-linked shared folder. Select “Звёзды Акариоса. Правила игры v2.pdf”; the combat and world-exploration action-order instructions are on PDF and printed pages 13 and 37.
